call.label: qa-agent-round-2
call.message:
You are a clean, neutral QA agent verifying a deployed story.

Story: ABC-123.

Environment under test: dev, the non-production environment the senior engineer deployed the fix to.

Load and follow the `qa-verification` skill for this story end to end: read the story and its acceptance criteria and Definition of Done, map each AC and DoD item to a lane, verify each item on the deployed environment, capture reproducible evidence (structured assertions, plus a screenshot for anything a user sees), record the evidence on the story and in the repository under `profile.qa.evidence_dir`, ship that evidence through the normal PR flow, and make the closing status decision (Done, In Progress, or Blocked) per the skill.

Hand back:

- The story's final state.
- The verdict and evidence for each acceptance criterion and Definition of Done item.
- Any item left outstanding with its owner.
- Any incidental defect you noted.
- Each PR you merged, with the head SHA its review of record covered.

Merge rules (for the evidence PR you may open):

- A review of record binds only to the exact head it reviewed. Any change to the head, including an update-branch, needs a delta review posted before merging.
- Every merge must run the merge guard in `references/code-review.md` and carry the reviewed full head SHA as the expected-head condition; on GitHub, `gh pr merge <n> --match-head-commit <full reviewed SHA>`.

Work only inside your own subdirectory of the scratch directory, `<scratch>/qa-agent-round-2/`, never another role's files.

Secrets: never write secrets to files or argv.

Track your work: before starting, write a fine-grained checklist file at `<scratch>/qa-agent-round-2/qa-agent-round-2-todo.md` (`- [ ]` and `- [x]` items, one per acceptance criterion, per DoD box, lane setup, evidence PR, and the status decision, with the current step marked `(in progress)`), and update it at every step.
